purpose: Evaluate the integrated D working tree as a possible future operating/frozen baseline without replacing or mutating the immutable C11-C 2.19.12 reference.

D4.8 activation governance is explicitly authorized by a separate approved checkpoint; this candidate preflight cannot grant authorization.

D9.16 full acceptance passes against the complete evidence packet and authorized media evidence.
D9.17 closure adjudication is PASS/CLOSED after the required evidence is reviewed.

A separate D baseline approval/freeze checkpoint authorizes the exact candidate source identity and hash.
